crossRefs.note: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean. Put away the evil of your doings from before my eyes. Cease to do evil.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
Cast away from you all your transgressions, in which you have transgressed; and make yourself a new heart and a new…
“Either make the tree good, and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt, and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known…
For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.
These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”
You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.
“Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but…
The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is…
Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.
I have seen your abominations, even your adulteries, and your neighing, the lewdness of your prostitution, on the hills…
If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.
I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.
Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and…
And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: Jerusalem, wash your heart from wickedness, that you may be saved. How long will your evil thoughts lodge within you?
translations.bsb: Wash the evil from your heart, O Jerusalem, so that you may be saved. How long will you harbor wicked thoughts within you?
translations.kjv: O Jerusalem, wash thine heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within
translations.asv: O Jerusalem, wash thy heart from wickedness, that thou mayest be saved. How long shall thine evil thoughts lodge within thee?
